Problem
Some committed `beforeinput` text and line-break events do not reach the Browser TextBox's managed `Text`. Spaces and newlines are lost. Related: #19097.

## Reproduction
With Android 15, Chrome 124 and Gboard 14.2 Korean two-set:
1. Open a Browser TextBox with `AcceptsReturn=true`, `TextWrapping=Wrap`, width 140, and `TextInputOptions.Multiline=true`.
2. Type `가`, Space, `나`, Enter, `다`, Enter twice, `라`, Space.
3. Expected `Text`: `가 나\n다\n\n라 `. The baseline loses spaces/line breaks; the candidate preserves them.

Selection coverage also uses Latin text: set `Text` to `A\nB\nC`, select all and send CDP `Input.insertText("Z")`. Stock 11.3.22 leaves the value unchanged; the patched backport replaces the selection with `Z`.

## Fix
Forward committed text and multiline line breaks once. Preserve managed selection when the DOM selection represents only the current paragraph. Use TEXTAREA for multiline clients and retain native INPUT completion behavior for single-line clients.

The single-line regression sequence ㄱ, ㅏ, Enter, ㄴ, ㅏ, Space produces `가 나 `, matching a plain HTML INPUT and preserving Gboard's emitted space without separating the jamo.

This updates the legacy input bridge. The EditContext implementation is tracked separately in #21347.

## Testing
- Head `2834f722`: **11/11 JavaScript tests**, with managed interop stubbed.
- Actual Chrome/Gboard: composition, spaces, soft wrapping, Enter, deletion and cursor editing.
- 11.3.22 backport, synthetic browser input: **29 selection, 15 focus/clipboard and 14 readonly/reattachment cases passed**.
- Full upstream build: blocked by missing SDK assemblies. Build-task and Bun bundle stages passed on the combined tree containing the follow-up focus fix.
- Remaining platform coverage: Firefox, Safari, other IMEs and multithreaded WASM.
